quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Nara's 2022-2031 fifth comprehensive plan, front-policy period, official project-progress route, active latter-policy transition, FY2026 budget, and FY2024 settlement/major-measures route. Draft and survey input are not treated as enacted policy or independent achievement/causal evidence.
